BOW STREET MAGISTRATES COURT // COMMITTAL PROCEEDINGS FOR NOBLE COLLATERAL LARCENY.
1. Person George Burnwell [ID:P531] is named as Prime Accused and high-society gambler.
2. Person George Burnwell [ID:P531] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-BURNWELL-GAMBLING].
3. Charges framed under Larceny Act Section 20 (Theft of Pledged Security) and Conspiracy to Defraud.
4. Person Alexander Holder [ID:P532] is named as Senior Partner of Holder & Stevenson Banking Firm.
5. Person Alexander Holder [ID:P532] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-HOLDER-BANKING].
6. Person Arthur Holder [ID:P533] is named as Son and Co-Accused wrongly implicated in theft.
7. Person Arthur Holder [ID:P533] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-ARTHUR-CLUB].
8. Person Mary Holder [ID:P534] owns account [Bank:010; Account:ACC-MARY-COVERT] and acted as secret confederate of Burnwell.
9. Prosecution establishes that Accused P531 seduced and conspired with Mary Holder to steal the £50,000 Beryl Coronet pledged by an illustrious client, wiring $220,000 through gaming conduits.
